list_workspaces.title: List workspaces
list_workspaces.description: List the Asters workspaces the API key's user is a member of, each with its id and name. The workspace id is needed to list social accounts and labels.

data.description: The workspaces, each with _id and name.

list_social_accounts.title: List a workspace's social accounts
list_social_accounts.description: List the social accounts connected to a workspace (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and others), each with its id, platform and name. The account id is what list_posts and list_post_analytics take.

list_labels.title: List a workspace's labels
list_labels.description: List every label defined in a workspace. Labels are the tags Asters users attach to posts to organise them.

list_posts.title: List a social account's posts
list_posts.description: Page through the posts of one social account, optionally limited to a date range. Each post has its text, status, media (with temporary download URLs), labels and a link to the published post. Read-only despite using POST.

social_account_id.description: The social account id, from list_social_accounts.

filters.description: Filters for the list, e.g. {"date": {"from": "04-01-2025", "to": "04-30-2025"}} with dates as MM-DD-YYYY.

list_post_analytics.title: List a social account's post analytics
list_post_analytics.description: Page through per-post analytics for one social account, optionally limited to a date range: impressions, reach, engagement and similar metrics for each published post. Read-only despite using POST.

social_account_id.description: The social account id, from list_social_accounts.

filters.description: Filters for the list, e.g. {"date": {"from": "04-01-2025", "to": "04-30-2025"}} with dates as MM-DD-YYYY.
